sens_en: to mark, to divide, to row
origine_fr: Le Shuowen jiezi écrit 劃 et le glose « entailler au couteau » : 刀 et 畫, tracer, qui donne aussi le son. La simplification l'écrit 划, un caractère qui voulait dire « ramer ». On lit 戈 et 刂, deux armes qui tranchent : tracer, séparer.
origine_en: The Shuowen jiezi writes 劃 and glosses it as “to cut with a knife”: 刀 and 畫, to draw, which also gives the sound. Simplification writes it as 划, a character that meant “to row”. You read 戈 and 刂, two cutting weapons: to mark, to divide.
